episodeTitle.en: Product lessons from Waymo | Shweta Shrivastava (Waymo, Amazon, Cisco)
episodeTitle.zh: Waymo的产品经验启示 | 施维塔·什里瓦斯塔瓦（Waymo、亚马逊、思科）

guestBioOfficial.en: Shweta Shrivastava is a Senior Product Leader at Waymo, an autonomous driving technology company backed by Alphabet. Prior to joining Waymo, she was the CPO of Nauto, where she also worked on AI-assisted driver tools. Shweta has worked in product for over 15 years in senior roles at several companies, including Amazon and Cisco. In today’s episode, we discuss: • How Waymo builds trust with riders
guestBioOfficial.zh: 施维塔·施里瓦斯塔瓦（Shweta Shrivastava）是Alphabet旗下自动驾驶技术公司Waymo的资深产品负责人。加入Waymo之前，她曾担任Nauto的首席产品官，期间也致力于开发AI辅助驾驶工具。施维塔在产品领域拥有超过15年的经验，曾在亚马逊、思科等多家公司担任高级职位。本期节目中，我们将探讨：• Waymo如何建立与乘客的信任

title.en: Product lessons from Waymo | Shweta Shrivastava (Waymo, Amazon, Cisco)
title.zh: Waymo的产品经验启示 | 施维塔·什里瓦斯塔瓦（Waymo、亚马逊、思科）

summary.en: Shweta shares product lessons from building autonomous vehicles, including how Waymo creates human-like driving behaviors and treats safety as the foundational product principle. She covers key lessons from her career at Amazon, Cisco, and startups about customer-centric product management, and why listening and empathy are core PM skills in complex technical environments. The episode is a fascinating look at product management inside one of the most advanced AI deployments on the roads today.
summary.zh: Shweta 分享了打造自动驾驶汽车的产品经验，包括 Waymo 如何创造类人的驾驶行为、并将安全视为基础性的产品原则。她讲到了在 Amazon、Cisco 以及初创公司生涯中关于“以客户为中心的产品管理”的关键心得，以及为什么在复杂技术环境中，倾听与同理心是产品经理的核心技能。本期是对当今道路上最先进 AI 部署之一内部产品管理的精彩透视。
